content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 identifies the service as bundled into another paid service, and the previous correction and resubmission did not resolve that denial. The case provides no evidence supporting separate payment, so a medical-necessity appeal or peer-to-peer review lacks a supported basis to overturn the bundling determination. This contractual denial cannot be shifted to the patient merely because a deductible remains; write off the balance.","action":"write_off"}
